notes: curated: lt.json#pensionagefemale | euromod value in force at 2025-06-01: 64.66 from 2025-01-01 | HARD / derive — official pension age for women in 2025: 64 years 8 months, stated by I-549 art. 57 as a STEP SCHEDULE (+4 months per year, reaching 65 in 2026), never as a decimal: the pipeline must pick the 2025 row and convert months to a decimal. VALUE: the law's 64 + 8/12 = 64.6667 (four decimals; the 1e-6 relative tolerance accepts the exact quotient 64.6666…). EUROMOD stores 64.66 — a truncation, not a rounding, 0.0067 years (2.4 days) short of the statute: kept as a real difference on the IE 27 382/27 383 precedent and reported to the economists team, not absorbed. ROUTING: the law's value differs from the stored 64.66 -> `changed` (route_against_current agrees). The 2026-09-08 Luna run derived 64.6667 correctly and was rejected only because the store carried unit `currency` for an age (the export says `age_years`; the store was ingested from the August export) — re-ingest fixed the unit.
